title: Three Copies, Same Face
description:
Before Deployments owned the world, ReplicaSets kept copies honest.

Ops wants a ReplicaSet with a fixed count and selectors that actually own the pods. Then they ask you to **scale once** — same template, different count. Rewrite-the-spec-from-scratch is the wrong move.

Leave the replicas Running and selected.

**Meant for:** ReplicaSets.

problemStatement.brief: Stand up a ReplicaSet with matching selectors, then scale it once without rewriting the pod template.
